t: You're looking at Sarum Chase, a large detached neo-Tudor mansion at 23 West Heath Road in Hampstead. The architectural writer Nikolaus Pevsner called it pure Hollywood Tudor. It was commissioned by the painter Frank Salisbury, who lived here. Salisbury was known as Britain's Painter Laureate, and made a fortune on both sides of the Atlantic. He painted portraits and large canvases of ceremonial events, and he was a fierce critic of modern art. A conservative taste in painting, then, and a very theatrical taste in houses.
